title: French Knafeh Croissants
description: A French twist on the classic Middle Eastern dessert, featuring flaky croissants and a nutty knafeh filling.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine warm milk and yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
2. Add sugar, flour, and salt to the bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
4. Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch. Cut into triangles.
5. Roll each triangle into a croissant shape.
6. Place the croissants on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
7. In a separate bowl, mix together knafeh, sugar, and nutmeg.
8. Place a spoonful of the knafeh mixture at the wide end of each croissant.
9. Fold the croissant in half and press the edges to seal.
10. Brush the tops with egg wash and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes.
11. Allow the croissants to cool for 5 minutes before serving.
